headline.purpose: Incident banner title, tile and command values, metric counts.

shadows.name: shadow-pop

shadows.name: shadow-modal

shadows.name: selection-ring

motion.name: ease

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:32px; padding:5px 12px; border:1px solid var(--border-strong,#323943); border-radius:6px; background:var(--panel,#13161a); color:var(--text,#e8eaed); font:500 14px/20px inherit; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn:hover { background:var(--panel-2,#1a1e24); } .ds-btn-primary { background:var(--accent,#3b7cf0); border-color:var(--accent,#3b7cf0); color:#fff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--accent,#3b7cf0); filter:brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-fg,#7aa9ff); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive or emergency action, solid red.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height:32px; padding:5px 12px; border:1px solid var(--red,#d93a40); border-radius:6px; background:var(--red,#d93a40); color:#fff; font:500 14px/20px inherit; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { filter:brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-fg,#7aa9ff); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; font-size:13px; font-weight:500; color:var(--text-2,#b9bfc8); } .ds-input { padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid var(--border-strong,#323943); border-radius:6px; background:var(--panel,#13161a); color:var(--text,#e8eaed); font:14px/20px inherit; transition:border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:var(--muted,#8b94a1); } .ds-input:focus { outline:none; border-color:var(--accent,#3b7cf0); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft,rgba(76,141,255,.14)); }

components.name: Status Pills
components.description: State text on soft tint; evacuation solid; demo neutral outline.
components.html: Normal Stale Alarm Evacuation Demo
components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-block; padding:2px 8px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:6px; font:600 12px/16px inherit; } .ds-ok { color:var(--green-fg,#56c878); background:var(--green-soft,rgba(47,168,79,.14)); } .ds-warn { color:var(--amber-fg,#e3b54a); background:var(--amber-soft,rgba(212,161,30,.14)); } .ds-bad { color:var(--red-fg,#ff7b72); background:var(--red-soft,rgba(229,72,77,.14)); } .ds-evac { color:#fff; background:var(--deep-red,#a8231f); } .ds-demo { color:var(--text-2,#b9bfc8); border-color:var(--border-strong,#323943); }

components.name: Scope Chip
components.description: Floor / apartment / room selector; selected adds accent border, tint and 1px ring.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height:32px; padding:4px 10px 4px 12px; border:1px solid var(--border,#23282f); border-radius:6px; background:var(--panel,#13161a); color:var(--text-2,#b9bfc8); font:500 14px inherit; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .15s, background-color .15s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color:var(--muted,#8b94a1); color:var(--text,#e8eaed); } .ds-on { border-color:var(--accent,#3b7cf0); background:var(--accent-soft,rgba(76,141,255,.14)); color:var(--text,#e8eaed); box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--accent,#3b7cf0); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-fg,#7aa9ff); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Panel surface with hairline and no shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background:var(--panel,#13161a); border:1px solid var(--border,#23282f); border-radius:8px; padding:16px; color:var(--text,#e8eaed); } .ds-card h3 { margin:0 0 12px; font:600 14px inherit; } .ds-card p { margin:0; color:var(--text-2,#b9bfc8); font-size:14px; }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: 232px rail destinations with a red incident count badge.
components.html: ManagerDispatch 2Sensors
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; width:208px; } .ds-nav a { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; height:34px; padding:0 10px; border-radius:6px; color:var(--text-2,#b9bfc8); font:500 14px inherit; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color .15s; } .ds-nav a:hover { background:var(--panel-2,#1a1e24); color:var(--text,#e8eaed); } .ds-nav a.ds-active { background:var(--panel-2,#1a1e24); color:var(--text,#e8eaed); font-weight:600; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-fg,#7aa9ff); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-count { margin-left:auto; min-width:20px; padding:1px 6px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--red,#d93a40); color:#fff; font:600 12px/16px inherit; text-align:center; }

components.name: State Cell
components.description: Compact 30px cell for matrices and grids; tone sets colour, none is dashed.
components.html: ! ~ !
components.css: .ds-cell { --fg:var(--muted,#8b94a1); --bg:var(--well,#0f1215); --line:var(--border-strong,#323943); display:inline-grid; place-items:center; width:30px; height:30px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:6px; background:var(--bg); color:var(--fg); font:600 13px inherit; } .ds-att { --fg:var(--amber-fg,#e3b54a); --bg:var(--amber-soft,rgba(212,161,30,.14)); --line:var(--amber,#d4a11e); } .ds-dng { --fg:var(--red-fg,#ff7b72); --bg:var(--red-soft,rgba(229,72,77,.14)); --line:var(--red,#d93a40); } .ds-none { --line:var(--border,#23282f); border-style:dashed; }

components.name: Evacuation Banner
components.description: Deep red panel, 8px radius, with a 4px black-and-amber tape strip along the top; the only loud surface in the system. Only the exit pictogram pulses.
components.html:
Evacuation in progress

Building 7, 14 residents unaccounted
components.css: .ds-evac { position:relative; overflow:hidden; border-radius:8px; background:#a8231f; color:#fff; } .ds-evac::before { content:""; position:absolute; inset:0 0 auto 0; height:4px; background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,#111 0 8px,#e0aa1c 8px 16px); } .ds-evac-head { padding:22px 20px 18px; } .ds-evac h2 { margin:0 0 4px; font:600 24px inherit; letter-spacing:-0.02em; }

narrative.overview: A building-safety operations console for a dispatcher under time pressure, with a manager and a technician behind them. Cool near-neutral surfaces, 1px hairlines, one blue accent, precise Inter type with tabular numerals. Dark is the default; light is a full second theme on the same token names. Colour means state and nothing else; with every other surface held neutral, an alarm is the loudest thing on any screen. The shell reports building state on every page through the incident count on the Dispatch destination.
keyCharacteristics: Three surface steps (ground, panel, raised) separated by 1px hairlines, not shadows.
State colour has three steps each: solid, text, soft tint, re-tuned per theme.
Long repeated lists collapse into compact state cells and matrices with the full sentence on tooltip and accessible name.
Evacuation is the one place the system gets loud: deep red, a slim black-and-amber tape strip, ISO pictograms.

rules.name: The State-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red mean state. They never decorate, never mark a category, never fill a series.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means "you can act on this" or "this is selected". Motion cells use blue as selection-like info, never as a hazard.

rules.name: The Neutral Demo Rule
rules.body: The Demo badge is a neutral outlined pill. Demo is not a hazard state.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case at 12px muted. No uppercase, no tracked-out eyebrows or kickers.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numbers are tabular everywhere; never swap in a proportional face for a figure.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Cards, tiles and cells never carry a shadow at rest. Only overlays do.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: No glows, no coloured side stripes. A selected item uses the accent border plus a 1px ring.

dos: Do use green, amber and red only for state, always as a dot or fill plus text, with a soft tint behind it.
Do use the -text step of a colour for text and the solid step for dots, fills and borders.
Do keep blue for action and selection, and one primary button per panel.
Do build both themes from the same token names; add a light value whenever a dark one is added.
Do compact long repeated lists into state cells or matrices, keeping the full sentence as tooltip and accessible name.
Do separate chart series by dash pattern as well as by colour, and keep series to the five data colours.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion for every pulse.
donts: Don't use state colours to decorate or categorise.
Don't use blue or violet for hazard, or green / amber / red for series.
Don't add glows, coloured side stripes, or shadows at rest.
Don't add uppercase labels, eyebrows or kickers.
Don't treat Demo mode as a hazard state; keep its badge neutral and outlined.
Don't use the black-and-amber tape or deep red outside evacuation.
Don't introduce a fourth surface step or a radius beyond 4, 6, 8 and 12.
